name: Citadel: Core
summary: The innermost heart of the Muramite Citadel, saturated with Discord energy and guarded by elite forces.
description: The Citadel Core is the most secure and dangerous part of the Muramite Citadel Complex. Discord energy saturates every chamber, powering arcane conduits, war engines, and command nodes. Elite officers, arcane specialists, and high command operate here. The Core houses strategic planning halls, Discord reactors, fortified command chambers, and the deepest arcane infrastructure. Resistance infiltration is nearly impossible, and the Core’s defenses are overwhelming.
